name: DKAN Dataset RSS feed
description: Publishes a schema-driven RSS 2.0 feed of DKAN datasets at /datasets.rss.
project_description: Provides an RSS 2.0 feed of the datasets held in the DKANv2 metastore, served at /datasets.rss. The feed is produced by mapping properties of each dataset's dataset.json onto RSS channel/item elements according to a JSON template (dataset.rss.feed.json). The template controls which dataset properties fill which RSS fields, supports nested property paths, per-field formatters (e.g. RFC822 dates), XML attributes, sorting and an item limit. The default template ships with the module; it can be customized by copying dataset.rss.feed.json into the DKAN schema directory and editing it there. Depends on DKAN (dkan, dkan_metastore) and Facets, plus symfony/property-access.
